headline: Data Analyst
summary: Licensed mathematics teacher of six years moving into data analysis. As my school's data coordinator I analyse learner assessment results in Excel, build the charts our principal presents to the division office, and use statistics to spot which sections need intervention. I am looking for an analyst role where I can apply this with larger and messier data.

experience.title: Mathematics Teacher and School Data Coordinator
experience.paragraph: Teach Grade 9 and 10 mathematics and, since 2024, also serve as the school's data coordinator for about 1,400 learners.
bullets: Analyse quarterly test results by competency and section, and present item-analysis charts at school learning action cell meetings.
Built an Excel workbook that combines grades, attendance and reading levels, and flags learners at risk of failing.
Used simple statistical tests to check whether a remedial program raised scores; the gain was significant and the program was extended.
Write lesson plans and assessment tools aligned to the curriculum guide, and evaluate how well each unit worked.

skill_groups.label: Analysis
items: Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, what-if analysis)

skill_groups.label: Communication
items: presenting findings to school heads and parents

projects.name: Barangay nutrition survey
projects.description: Cleaned and summarised 800 household survey forms for a barangay health office and presented the results at a barangay assembly.

education.credential: Bachelor of Secondary Education, major in Mathematics
